sections.text_helper: Section 19.3.3 "Clock selection" in chapter 19 (General-purpose timers (TIM14)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 525.
sections.section_content:
The counter clock can be provided by the following clock sources:
• Internal clock (CK_INT)
Internal clock source (CK_INT)
The internal clock source is the default clock source for TIM14.
Figure176 shows the behavior of the control circuit and the upcounter in normal mode,
without prescaler.
[Figure 176. Control circuit in normal mode, internal clock divided by 1]
